## About
Lauren Hill and Brooke Thompson started SOS-ASAP to bring softwash, wildlife management, chimney services and pest control together in one company. Brooke holds certifications in Wildlife Management (NWCOA), Pest Control, SoftWash Systems (SWS) and Chimney Sweeping (CSIA). Lauren and Brooke manage a well-diversified staff serving the larger Houston community.
Every job starts with a look at the problem. Our inspectors and technicians assess what's going on, then meet with you to talk through what needs to be done. No surprises later on, just the facts up front and a plan that works for you and your pocketbook.
Customers have rated us 4.8 on Google from 201 reviews. Reviewers mention our technicians by name, like Domingo, Manuel and Gene, and talk about how they took the time to explain what they were doing and why.

## Services
- Pest Control: Ant infestations, cockroaches, termites and wasps for homes and businesses. We inspect, explain what we found, and customize a treatment program.
- Wildlife Removal & Exclusions: Opossums, raccoons, rats, squirrels and snakes. A technician identifies the animal, finds the point of entry and other likely ones, and recommends the best ways to keep them from coming back.
- Chimney caps and vent guards: Custom ordered chimney caps and vent guards installed to help keep nuisance wildlife out after removal.
- Chimney Services/Gas Logs: One reviewer had a fireplace and dryer vent cleaned on a newly purchased home, and another had new gas logs set up for her elderly in-laws.
- SoftWashing Services: SoftWashing for your home, office and apartment building.
- Pet Waste Removal: Pet waste removal for your yard, alongside lawn sanitization and lawn deodorizing.
- Mosquito mister repair and maintenance: One customer used us to repair and maintain her mosquito mister.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free quotes?
A: Yes. Contact us and we'll give you a free quote on any service we offer.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Our site lists Katy, Missouri City, River Oaks, Memorial, Galleria, Cypress, Bellaire, Sugarland, The Woodlands, Magnolia, Tomball, Mission Bend, West University, League City, Pearland, Richmond, Rosenberg and surrounding areas. Give us a call to check your address.

Q: Do you have a referral program?
A: Yes. You can earn $40 for referring a friend or yourself through one of our separate types of services. Minor restrictions apply.
